import { provenanceLabel } from "@/components/gaps/provenance-label"
import { provenanceOf } from "@/lib/gaps/provenance"
export function Probe({ slug, copy }: { slug: string; copy: any }) {
    return <span data-provenance={provenanceOf(slug)}>{provenanceLabel(provenanceOf(slug), copy)}</span>
}
